# Agent tools reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tools_reference.py from paralingo/agent_tools.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Paralingo exposes 11 tools in Anthropic, OpenAI and MCP formats:

```python
from paralingo import SpeechProfileTools

tools = SpeechProfileTools("profiles", agent_id="my-agent", include_pipeline_tools=False)
tools.definitions("anthropic")   # or "openai" or "mcp"
tools.execute("paralingo_get_summary", {"speaker_id": "caller-42"})   # returns a JSON string
```

`execute` returns `{"ok": true, "result": ...}` or `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}` and never raises.

| Tool | Who calls it | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`paralingo_get_summary`](#paralingo_get_summary) | LLM | Load a compact snapshot of how this person speaks: emotional state, communication-skill scores, speaking style, accent, active (non-diagnostic) speech indicators, recent agent observations and concrete guidance for how to talk to them. |
| [`paralingo_get_guidance`](#paralingo_get_guidance) | LLM | Get the latest adaptations for talking to this person (speaking rate, how long to wait before replying, tone). |
| [`paralingo_read_section`](#paralingo_read_section) | LLM | Read one raw section of the speech profile file for detailed reasoning (e.g. 'sessions' for per-utterance pitch/pauses/fluency, 'baseline' for the person's norms, 'trends'). |
| [`paralingo_get_trend`](#paralingo_get_trend) | LLM | Longitudinal trend of one speech metric across sessions, with direction and the personal baseline. |
| [`paralingo_query_observations`](#paralingo_query_observations) | LLM | Read earlier observations that agents recorded about this person, optionally by category. |
| [`paralingo_add_observation`](#paralingo_add_observation) | LLM | Record an evidence-backed observation about how the person speaks or feels, so future agents can use it. |
| [`paralingo_update_accent`](#paralingo_update_accent) | LLM | Record an accent / regional-variety estimate and/or observed phonetic markers (e.g. 'non-rhotic', 'retroflex t', 'th-stopping'), or an intelligibility score (0-1, e.g. mean ASR confidence). |
| [`paralingo_start_session`](#paralingo_start_session) | Your pipeline code | Open a new conversation session for the speaker. |
| [`paralingo_analyze_utterance`](#paralingo_analyze_utterance) | Your pipeline code | Analyse one user turn (audio WAV and/or transcript and/or ASR word timestamps): pitch, loudness, pauses, rate, voice quality, fluency, vocabulary, sentiment, emotion and skills; store it and return findings plus updated guidance. |
| [`paralingo_end_session`](#paralingo_end_session) | Your pipeline code | Close the session: summarise it, update the personal baseline, trends, skill scores, speaking style, speech indicators and guidance. |
| [`paralingo_set_consent`](#paralingo_set_consent) | Your pipeline code | Record the person's consent choices. |

**LLM tools** are safe to give a model. **Pipeline tools** are hidden when you create `SpeechProfileTools(..., include_pipeline_tools=False)`, because they need audio or change consent.

## LLM tools

### paralingo_get_summary

Load a compact snapshot of how this person speaks: emotional state, communication-skill scores, speaking style, accent, active (non-diagnostic) speech indicators, recent agent observations and concrete guidance for how to talk to them. Call at the start of every conversation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |

### paralingo_get_guidance

Get the latest adaptations for talking to this person (speaking rate, how long to wait before replying, tone). Cheap; call whenever you want to re-check mid-conversation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |

### paralingo_read_section

Read one raw section of the speech profile file for detailed reasoning (e.g. 'sessions' for per-utterance pitch/pauses/fluency, 'baseline' for the person's norms, 'trends').

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `section` | one of: `speaker`, `consent`, `baseline`, `accent`, `sessions`, `observations`, `assessments`, `trends`, `agent_guidance`, `audit_log` | yes |  |
| `last_n` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 50) |  | For list sections: return only the last N items (default 3 for sessions, 20 otherwise). |

### paralingo_get_trend

Longitudinal trend of one speech metric across sessions, with direction and the personal baseline.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `metric` | one of: `f0_mean_hz`, `f0_std_semitones`, `rms_dbfs_mean`, `jitter_local_pct`, `shimmer_local_pct`, `hnr_db`, `words_per_minute`, `articulation_rate_sps`, `pause_ratio`, `filler_rate_per_100w`, `stuttering_like_per_100_syllables`, `type_token_ratio`, `hedge_rate_per_100w`, `valence`, `arousal`, `response_latency_s` | yes |  |
| `last_n` | integer (≥ 2, ≤ 100) |  |  |

### paralingo_query_observations

Read earlier observations that agents recorded about this person, optionally by category.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `category` | one of: `accent`, `behavior`, `communication`, `emotion`, `health_indicator`, `other`, `preference`, `speech_pattern`, `voice_quality` |  |  |
| `limit` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |  |  |

### paralingo_add_observation

Record an evidence-backed observation about how the person speaks or feels, so future agents can use it. Cite evidence (metrics, quotes) and be honest about confidence. Use 'health_indicator' only for non-diagnostic signals; never assert a medical condition.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `category` | one of: `accent`, `behavior`, `communication`, `emotion`, `health_indicator`, `other`, `preference`, `speech_pattern`, `voice_quality` | yes |  |
| `observation` | string | yes | One clear sentence. |
| `confidence` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | yes |  |
| `evidence` | array of strings |  |  |
| `reasoning` | string |  |  |
| `session_id` | string |  | Session (call) id. Omit to use the speaker's active session. |
| `utterance_id` | string |  |  |

### paralingo_update_accent

Record an accent / regional-variety estimate and/or observed phonetic markers (e.g. 'non-rhotic', 'retroflex t', 'th-stopping'), or an intelligibility score (0-1, e.g. mean ASR confidence).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `label` | string |  | e.g. 'Indian English (Hindi L1)', 'Scottish English' |
| `confidence` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |  |  |
| `source` | string |  | Model or agent that produced the estimate. |
| `markers` | array of objects |  |  |
| `intelligibility` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |  |  |
| `session_id` | string |  | Session (call) id. Omit to use the speaker's active session. |

## Pipeline tools

### paralingo_start_session

Open a new conversation session for the speaker. Returns session_id.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `channel` | string |  | phone, web, app... |
| `context` | string |  | Purpose of the conversation. |

### paralingo_analyze_utterance

Analyse one user turn (audio WAV and/or transcript and/or ASR word timestamps): pitch, loudness, pauses, rate, voice quality, fluency, vocabulary, sentiment, emotion and skills; store it and return findings plus updated guidance.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `session_id` | string |  | Session (call) id. Omit to use the speaker's active session. |
| `transcript` | string |  | Verbatim transcript including fillers if possible. |
| `audio_path` | string |  | Path to a WAV file of this turn (inside the configured audio root). |
| `word_timestamps` | array of objects |  |  |
| `t_start` | number |  |  |
| `t_end` | number |  |  |
| `response_latency_s` | number |  | Silence between the agent finishing and the user starting. |
| `external` | object |  | Other model outputs, e.g. {"emotion": {"label": "angry", "confidence": 0.8, "arousal": 0.7, "valence": -0.6, "model": "ser-x"}, "asr_confidence": 0.92} |

### paralingo_end_session

Close the session: summarise it, update the personal baseline, trends, skill scores, speaking style, speech indicators and guidance.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `session_id` | string |  | Session (call) id. Omit to use the speaker's active session. |

### paralingo_set_consent

Record the person's consent choices. Only call after the person has explicitly agreed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speaker_id` | string | yes | Stable id of the person (e.g. hashed phone number or CRM id). |
| `recording` | boolean |  |  |
| `voice_analysis` | boolean |  |  |
| `health_indicators` | boolean |  |  |
| `store_transcripts` | boolean |  |  |
| `retention_days` | integer (≥ 1) |  |  |
| `granted_via` | string |  |  |
